Employee Benefits Policy
Health Insurance:
All full-time employees are covered under the company health insurance plan. Coverage includes hospitalization and basic medical expenses. Provident Fund:
The company contributes to the employee provident fund as per government regulations. Bonus Policy:
Annual performance-based bonuses are awarded based on individual and company performance. Reimbursements:
Employees may claim reimbursements for approved travel, meals, and training expenses. All reimbursement claims must be submitted within 30 days.

Company Overview
ABC Technologies is a mid-sized software services company operating in India. The company provides software development, data analytics, and IT consulting services. Departments:
- Engineering
- Product Management
- Human Resources
- Sales and Marketing
- IT Support
Working Hours:
Office hours are from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees are expected to be available during core working hours from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Remote Work:
Remote or hybrid work is allowed with prior approval from the reporting manager. Employees working remotely must follow IT security guidelines.

Employee Handbook
Leave Policy:
Employees must request leave at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal. Manager approval is mandatory for all leave requests. Types of Leave:
- Casual Leave: 12 days per calendar year
- Sick Leave: Medical certificate required if leave exceeds 2 consecutive days
- Earned Leave: Accumulated monthly and can be carried forward
Attendance Policy:
Employees must mark daily attendance using the HR system. More than 3 late arrivals in a month may require an explanation to HR. Code of Conduct:
Employees must maintain professional behavior at the workplace. Harassment, discrimination, or misconduct will result in disciplinary action.

IT Security Policy
Password Policy:
Employees must not share passwords with anyone. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and follow complexity rules. Device Usage:
Company-issued laptops must be used for official work only. Personal devices are not allowed to access company systems without approval. Remote Access and VPN:
VPN access is mandatory when working from outside the office network. Employees must connect to the company VPN before accessing internal tools. Software Installation:
Installing unauthorized software is strictly prohibited. All software requests must be approved by the IT department.

Employee Onboarding Guide
First Day Checklist:
- Report to HR for document verification
- Collect employee ID card
- Receive laptop and system access
System Access:
Employees must raise an IT ticket to request email and tool access. Access is typically granted within 1 working day. HR Support:
For HR-related queries, employees can contact the HR team via email or the HR portal. IT Support:
For technical issues, employees should contact the IT helpdesk. Critical issues should be reported immediately.

Employee Handbook
Leave Policy:
Employees must request leave at least 2 weeks in advance. Manager approval is required.
